record.one_liner: Lark (Larksuite) enterprise collaboration suite exposing Open Platform server APIs for messaging, docs, calendar, base and more
record.auth_notes: App ID and App Secret from the Developer Console are used as credentials (api_key). Tokens are tenant_access_token (app acts as itself), app_access_token, and user_access_token obtained through an OAuth 2.0 user authorization flow (oauth2). Lark does not document a basic username/password path.
record.access_notes: Developers can create a custom app themselves, but the permissions the app requests must be reviewed by the tenant administrator for custom apps. Store apps need a Lark launch review plus tenant installation review. Free-plan status of the developer account was not verified.
record.api_notes: Server API docs cover many product areas (Contacts, Messaging, Docs, Calendar, Base, Approval, Tasks, Email, Admin and others). The fetched pages describe the APIs as a rich set but did not explicitly state the HTTP style, so REST is inferred from the Server API structure and sets confidence to medium.
record.blocker_notes: Custom app permissions need tenant administrator approval, and production distribution to other tenants would need Lark store app review. Building and testing inside one's own tenant is possible now.
